# Dimensure

> Dimensure is a 3D laser scanning and construction quality-control survey company based in Corby, Northamptonshire, UK. It scans estate roads, house plots, buildings and gardens with a Trimble X9 survey-grade terrestrial laser scanner and reports whether what has been built matches the design.

Key facts:

- Services: Dimensure Design Audit (pre-construction review of groundworks and civils drawings for any project, including housing, commercial, industrial and infrastructure; used by designers and engineers, housebuilders, main contractors, and groundworks/civils contractors: levels, drainage, foundations, cross-drawing clashes; graded issue log with suggested fixes for the designer and indicative fix costs; from £495 per site); road and sub-base laser scanning against design levels; tarmac (asphalt) depth surveys by before-and-after scan comparison; plot and oversite scanning (slab flatness, brickwork dimensions to drawing, drain collar positions); 3D measured building surveys; garden and landscape scanning.
- Areas served: the whole of the Midlands as standard (travel included within 50 miles of Corby, e.g. Northampton, Leicester, Coventry, Nottingham, Peterborough, Milton Keynes, Bedford, Cambridge); anywhere else in the UK with travel charged.
- Quality: scans are processed by software, then every report is checked by the Dimensure team, who sense-check results against drawings and site and flag problems.
- Equipment: Trimble X9, manufacturer-specified 2 mm range accuracy and 2.3 mm 3D point accuracy at 10 m; every report states the registration error for the job.
- Turnaround: road and plot QC reports normally the next working day; measured building and garden surveys 3-5 working days.
- Guide prices (before VAT): plot checks from £85 per plot (4+ plots per visit); road scans from £495 per visit; tarmac depth surveys from £895 per section; measured building surveys from £325; garden scans from £395.
- Scope note: plot checks do not verify plot position on the site grid or level to site datum; those remain with the site engineer.
- Set up by a groundworks project manager with 12 years on UK housing sites (NVQ Level 6 Construction Contracting Operations Management, SMSTS, CSCS Black card).
- Contact: 01632 960247, info@dimensure.co.uk, https://dimensure.co.uk/contact.html

## Services

- [Road & Sub-base Laser Scanning | Level Checks to Design | Dimensure](https://dimensure.co.uk/road-scanning.html): Laser scan checks of estate road sub-base and binder against design levels. Full-surface heat-maps and pass/fail against your tolerances.
- [Tarmac Depth Surveys by Laser Scan | Layer Thickness Checks | Dimensure](https://dimensure.co.uk/tarmac-depth-surveys.html): Measure the tarmac thickness laid everywhere, without cores. Before-and-after laser scans map layer thickness against your spec.
- [Plot & Oversite Laser Scanning | Slab, Brickwork & Drain Checks | Dimensure](https://dimensure.co.uk/plot-oversite-scanning.html): Plot-by-plot laser scan QC: slab flatness, brickwork to drawing and drain collar positions checked at oversite. Pass/fail report next day.
- [3D Measured Building Surveys by Laser Scan | Kitchens, Extensions | Dimensure](https://dimensure.co.uk/measured-building-surveys.html): Millimetre-accurate 3D laser scan surveys for kitchens, extensions, architects and interiors. Floor plans, elevations and point cloud.
- [Groundworks & Civils Design Audit | Drawing Review | Dimensure](https://dimensure.co.uk/groundworks-design-audit.html): Independent review of groundworks and civils drawings before you dig: levels, drainage, foundations and clashes checked, with an issue log and fixes. From £495.
- [Garden & Landscape 3D Laser Scanning | Levels Surveys | Dimensure](https://dimensure.co.uk/garden-landscape-scanning.html): 3D laser scan garden surveys for designers, landscapers and homeowners. Every level, wall, step and tree, with a scaled levels plan. From £395.
- [Laser Scanning Services | Roads, Plots, Buildings, Gardens | Dimensure](https://dimensure.co.uk/services.html): Dimensure laser scanning services: road and sub-base scans, tarmac depth surveys, plot QC, 3D measured building surveys and garden scans.

- [Plot & Oversite Scan Cost 2026 | From £85 per Plot | Dimensure](https://dimensure.co.uk/plot-scan-cost.html): Plot and oversite scan cost: from £85 per plot when four or more are scanned in one visit, or £295 for a single-plot visit. All checks included.
- [Measured Building Survey Cost 2026 | 3D Laser Scan Prices | Dimensure](https://dimensure.co.uk/measured-building-survey-cost.html): Measured building survey cost: from £325 for a kitchen or room, £695 for whole-house plans, £995 with elevations. Point cloud included.
